subject: Supplier onboarding: tax docs & PO setup for OrbitalAI
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@orbitalai.com>, accounts@orbitalai.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding: tax docs & PO setup for OrbitalAI

Hi Samir / Orbital AI accounting team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get OrbitalAI set up as a Redwood supplier. To kick off procurement and vendor setup we need a few items from you so Finance can create the vendor record and issue POs: 

- Completed tax paperwork: W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN-E (for non-US entities). If you are VAT-registered in the EU, please include a copy of your VAT certificate.
- Vendor onboarding form (attached) filled and signed.
- Banking details for ACH / wire (bank name, routing, account name, account number, SWIFT/BIC if applicable).
- Legal company name and remit-to address as it should appear on the PO/invoice.

I've attached our VendorOnboardingChecklist.pdf to this message for your reference. Once we receive the completed docs Finance will run the verification and we typically issue a PO within 3-7 business days. If you have any procurement-specific requirements (e.g., special invoice remit instructions, VAT handling), please flag them.

Next step: can you confirm whether OrbitalAI is a US tax entity or has a non-US parent? That determines whether we request a W-9 or W-8BEN-E.

Thanks — looping in Marissa (CS) to help coordinate invoicing expectations on our side.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: VendorOnboardingChecklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@orbitalai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, accounts@orbitalai.com
Cc: procurement@orbitalai.com
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: tax docs & PO setup for OrbitalAI

Hi Lauren — thanks for the note and the checklist. Quick question: OrbitalAI is incorporated in Delaware (US) but we have an EU VAT-registered subsidiary for EMEA billing. Which forms do you need from us now? We can provide a US W-9 for the Delaware entity and a VAT certificate for the EU entity — do you want both on file?

Also, can you confirm invoice remit address for US invoices and whether Redwood supports VAT reverse-charge on EU invoices? Finally, we'll prepare bank details and the signed onboarding form — expect those from our accounting inbox shortly.

Best,
Samir Khan
Head of Finance, OrbitalAI
samir.khan@orbitalai.com

Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: tax docs & PO setup for OrbitalAI

Hi Samir — thanks for the quick reply and helpful context. From Finance:

- For the vendor record we need a completed W-9 for the US Delaware entity. Please attach the signed PDF (name field must match legal entity).
- For your EU subsidiary: please include the VAT registration certificate and the legal entity name used for EMEA invoices. We will store both records on file and associate the correct remit entity to POs/invoices by region.
- Banking: include ACH (routing + account) for US payments and SWIFT/BIC for non-US wires. We prefer an ACH-friendly account for US invoices.
- Please fill and sign the redwood_vendor_form.pdf attached here. That contains the remit-to, tax ID, and W-9/W-8 placeholders.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/link/abc123 (use this if you prefer e-signature)
HubSpot vendor record (for reference): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/OrbitalAI

Once we receive the W-9 and completed form Finance will verify the TIN and bank details. After verification we will issue a PO (target: within 5 business days). If any withholding is required it'll be communicated.

Thanks — happy to expedite if you flag the attachments in reply.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Senior Manager, Finance Operations
finance@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redwood_vendor_form.pdf (application/pdf); PO_terms.pdf (application/pdf)

Attachments:
- OrbitalAI_W-9.pdf (application/pdf)

A few notes:
- The W-9 is for OrbitalAI, Inc. (Delaware).
- Our EU VAT certificate will be shared in a separate email from the EMEA finance team later this week.
- Can you confirm the expected PO number format and whether Redwood requires the PO to be referenced on the invoice? We typically include PO numbers per request.

Thanks,
Accounting Team

accounts@orbitalai.com

Samir / Accounting team — got the W-9 and bank details, thank you. Confirming next steps from Redwood:

1) Finance will validate the W-9/TIN against IRS records and confirm that the account details match.
2) We will create the vendor record and issue a PO referencing PO-2026-0047 for the initial engagement. Target issuance: within 5 business days assuming verification completes without exception.
3) Please send the EU VAT certificate when available and we will map the EMEA remit entity accordingly.

Invoices: yes, please reference the PO number on invoices to ensure prompt payment. Our standard net terms are NET30 unless otherwise negotiated; if you require different terms flag it in reply.

I'll upload the attachments to our shared onboarding Drive folder and notify you when the PO is issued. If anything else is needed from procurement side I will follow up.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-onboarding-orbitalai
